description: Address 5 review issues: remove hardcoded credentials, fix Alembic async driver mismatch, optimize dashboard aggregation, add unique constraint on client_services, remove unused import.
steps: Step 1: Remove Railway password from config.py - default DATABASE_URL to sqlite+aiosqlite:///./contable.db for local dev
Step 2: Fix alembic.ini - use placeholder URL instead of hardcoded Railway credentials
Step 3: Fix .env.example - replace hardcoded Railway URL with placeholder
Step 4: Fix unbounded payment loading in dashboard - use SQL aggregation instead of loading all payments
Step 5: Add unique constraint on (client_id, service_id) in the Alembic migration for client_services table
Step 6: Remove unused extract import from reports.py
acceptance_criteria: No Railway credentials appear in source-controlled files
Dashboard endpoint uses SQL aggregation for revenue/pending calculations
client_services table has UniqueConstraint on (client_id, service_id)
No unused extract import in reports.py
findings: All 28 backend tests pass. Frontend build succeeds. No credentials remain in source-controlled application files. SQL aggregation used for dashboard and general report endpoints. UniqueConstraint added both in the Alembic migration and the SQLAlchemy model. The alembic.ini still uses asyncpg driver in the placeholder URL because env.py has a custom async runner (async_engine_from_config) that works with asyncpg.
